definitions.full: H6795. tsanach [ צָנַח ] verb descend (meaning inferred from context); — Qal Imperfect 3feminine singular הַחֲמוֺר מֵעַל וַתִּצְנַח Judg 1:14 = Josh 15:18 and she descended (alighted) from the ass ; ׳וַתּ בָּאָרֶץ Judg 4:21 and it (the tent-peg) went down into the ground .
